description: This file defines the CurlMultiHandler class, which manages asynchronous HTTP requests using curl_multi_* functions in GuzzleHttp. It handles request queuing, execution, cancellation, and message processing for concurrent HTTP requests.

classes.name: CurlMultiHandler
classes.description: Manages multiple concurrent HTTP requests using curl_multi_* functions, supporting request queuing, execution, cancellation, and message processing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the handler with optional configuration, setting up the handle factory, select timeout, and options.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Lazy-initializes the curl multi handle resource when accessed.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the curl multi handle resource upon object destruction.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles an HTTP request asynchronously, returning a promise.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Performs a single iteration of the curl multi event loop, managing delayed handles and processing messages.

methods.name: tickInQueue
methods.description: Runs curl_multi_exec inside the event queue to prevent busy looping.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Runs the event loop until all requests are completed.

methods.name: addRequest
methods.description: Adds a request handle to the queue, managing delays if specified.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing request handle and cleans up resources.

methods.name: processMessages
methods.description: Processes completed curl messages and resolves associated promises.

methods.name: timeToNext
methods.description: Calculates the time until the next scheduled delayed handle.
